what: Jabil designs and manufactures products for other companies across many industries: data centre hardware, medical devices, car electronics, capital equipment and consumer products.
customers: Cloud and data centre operators, medical device companies, carmakers, semiconductor equipment makers and consumer brands.
money: data centre hardware, networking and capital equipment
healthcare, automotive and renewable energy manufacturing
consumer products, warehouse automation and retail
moat: Engineering and manufacturing operations in many countries that customers depend on to shift production between regions as tariffs and demand change.
risks: Gross margin of 9% is thin, as is normal in contract manufacturing
Customers can move volume to a rival at contract renewal
Revenue has been roughly flat over three years outside the data centre surge
opportunities: Revenue grew about 21% last year with a return on invested capital of 22%
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
AI data centre hardware is the fastest-growing part of its mix
watch: Intelligent Infrastructure revenue growth and core operating margin.
